The [[Gorog]] [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] had a '''nest''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Kr]] in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]]. It possessed a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay, as well as a labyrinth of tunnels and a nesting chamber for the young. It was the site of a [[Battle of Kr|battle]] between the [[New Jedi Order]] and the Gorog.
